daily.summary: US government systems dominate the last 24 hours. An unclassified CIA and ODNI open-source intelligence system was breached, Colorado's myColorado state services app remains offline after a data theft, and the FBI director confirmed an active investigation into the NCIC database hack without naming a culprit. None of these has been attributed. CISA also listed an exploited Drupal core flaw and two others as known exploited.

weekly.summary: AI-assisted intrusion remains the week's main theme. The FBI, the UK NCSC, Google, Unit 42, Amazon and GreyNoise describe agentic attack frameworks in real operations, and Bell Canada and the European Commission say AI-driven attackers breached them. Energy operators feature prominently: Norway reportedly links Equinor and Skagerak Energi incidents to an exploited Azure API Management flaw, KEPCO disclosed a large data breach and a US uranium mine was disrupted. State-linked activity includes a China-nexus vCenter zero-day campaign, Russian espionage against Romanian and US targets, and North Korean financial theft. Breaches at US federal and state government systems, including the FBI's NCIC, a CIA/ODNI OSINT system, Colorado and West Virginia, remain unattributed.
